meta.title: A vendor who already bid cannot revise after the end is pulled in
gaps: The plan cannot verify the original bid's exact quote or explicitly confirm that counter_offer_modification_enabled is off.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer moves the round's bid end time with the increase auction time moved later.
Wait until the round's bid end time has passed.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “bid count” equals 1.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Order not active”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “bid count” equals 1.
